description: Redistributable subset of measured outdoor IV curves for Mitsubishi PV-UE125MF5N used by pvlib/PVLIB MATLAB PVsyst parameter-estimation tests.

subset.selection_note: 12 curves selected by deterministic farthest-point coverage in normalized effective-irradiance/cell-temperature space, restricted to upstream indices 0-2999 because pvlib's own fit_pvsyst_sandia regression test validates that range.

measurement_reference.title: Estimating Parameters for the PVsyst Version 6 Photovoltaic Module Performance Model
measurement_reference.notes: The report describes measured outdoor IV curves for a 36-cell Mitsubishi PV-UE125MF5N in Albuquerque, NM; cell temperature was estimated from three backsheet thermocouples and effective irradiance measured with a silicon reference cell.

redistribution.attribution: pvlib python Contributors; PVLIB python Development Team; Sandia National Laboratories
redistribution.modification: OpenSIMPV selected 12 source curves and changed the source curve-count line from 3585 to 12; numerical curve rows are otherwise copied unchanged.
